meta.provider: none: a local simulation of the Cirq Quantum Virtual Machine's published median calibration (2024-08-16); not a measurement of any device
meta.description: Three simulated days of Kickoff 35's design on 27 pairs, static (each pair keeps its noise) and scrambled (pairs swap noise between days), on the planted map of arm 2.

layout_note: 27 disjoint pairs split into 3 rounds of 9 by pair index mod 3, so Kickoff 35's 12-circuit mirror order applies unchanged: 4000 shots per circuit, 8000 per variant per edge, as on ibm_fez

scramble.rule: permutation redrawn from the same generator until no pair keeps its own noise

x_rule: on a scrambled day each pair's x is the x of the pair whose noise it carries (the published figure follows the noise)
seeds: counts drawn with default_rng(SeedSequence(day_seed, spawn_key=(position, pair_index))); static and scrambled share day seeds, so Day 1 is the same in both

analysis.rule: HOLDS: corrected r(k1,k3) >= 0.7 and worst-decile overlap Day 1 to Day 3 >= 50%; FADES: corrected r(k1,k2) < 0.5; PARTIAL otherwise
